verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python library, not an app with a built-in insights feature, but its CodeAgent writes code to run computations and can be pointed at your data. A community hands-on report shows the text_to_sql example producing a correct SQL query, then falling back to an ASCII bar chart because matplotlib was not in the allowed imports. Additional imports must be authorized explicitly, so the analysis capability is assembled by the developer rather than delivered out of the box. Missing for 10: a native in-product insights/suggestions experience, first-party docs on data-analysis workflows, built-in data connectors, and smooth visualization without manual import configuration.
